contract.reader: synwevo_docs.ingest.extract_context(data, filename, ocr=True): PNG/JPG/JPEG and a PDF's scanned pages (no readable text layer) are recognized page by page with the local engine (tesseract via engine/ocr.py); recognized lines carry source {page, line, recognized: true, confidence} (lowest word confidence on the line) and the file-level ocr summary counts pages/words/low-confidence words (threshold 60); at most CONTEXT_LIMITS['ocr_pages']=5 pages per file; a page mixing a text layer with pictures or hidden text still refuses (context_needs_ocr); images without the engine refuse (context_ocr_unsupported); engine timeout/error refuses (context_ocr_failed); the flag changes nothing for text formats
contract.capabilities: describe(): context_ocr, context_ocr_languages, image formats listed only when the engine exists; Suite capabilities: ocr, ocr_languages, ocr_pages
contract.worker: apps/suite agent/files.py asks the reader for recognition explicitly (ocr=True) only when the reader reports it; a reader without the flag keeps its old call; recognized context items carry recognized: true to the model payload and to the message's visible contexts
contract.wording: files.messages.ts: ocrOn capability notice, recognizedNotice/recognizedNone in the preview, sourceRecognized per line, ocrFailed; needsOcr/ocrUnsupported reworded; context.messages.ts personalFileRecognized on message source chips
